presence_rationale: Dedicated 'Managing non-financial risk at ANZ' section addressing the APRA capital overlay (operational-risk capital overlay) imposed for NFR weaknesses, Markets-business issues with Board oversight, and culture/risk reviews. This is a substantive systemic-risk disclosure even though framed as NFR rather than capital adequacy.
specificity_rationale: Names APRA capital overlay, CPS 220 Risk Management compliance, Financial Accountability Regime, NFR Management program post-Royal Commission, Internal Audit culture reviews, My Voice survey, Risk Culture Assessments, Risk Culture Action Plans. Names individuals (Paul O'Sullivan independent reviewer; Oliver Wyman commissioned for Markets review). Board-level remuneration consequences detailed. The SASB FN-CB-550a stress test integration into capital planning is partial — climate stress tests addressed, capital ratios not.
quantification_rationale: Reports remuneration impact (reduction in 2024 STVR, reduction in 2025 LTVR restricted rights granted Nov/Dec 2024). However, no G-SIB or D-SIB score, no CET1 / capital ratio numbers, no explicit numerical capital overlay amount in retrieved evidence. SASB FN-CB-550a metrics are partially missing.
